_help: Merch for sale. Add one entry per product and the Merch page and its menu link appear on their own. price is text exactly as shown ("£20"). image is optional: a square photo saved in assets/img/merch/. buyUrl is where the Buy button goes: a Bandcamp listing or a Stripe payment link (must start with https://). buyLabel is optional button text, such as "Buy on Bandcamp". Set soldOut to true to grey it out. Example item: { "name": "Better Off tee", "price": "£20", "detail": "Black, sizes S to XXL", "image": "assets/img/merch/better-off-tee.jpg", "buyUrl": "https://buy.stripe.com/...", "soldOut": false }
note: Orders are taken and posted through Bandcamp.
